title: Mountain's Persistence
description: Meng Hao shows unwavering resolve. 'A mountain does not move for wind, nor bend for storm.'

challenge.requirements: Endure 50 consecutive failures without giving up or changing approach
challenge.restriction: Cannot modify strategy or seek alternative methods

title: Dao of I Am Me
description: Meng Hao reveals the ultimate truth. 'I am me, regardless of what others think or do.'

challenge.requirements: Maintain perfect self-identity while reality itself tries to change you
challenge.restriction: Cannot rely on external validation or support
